title: C482/266/2007 of BRIJ MOHAN SETHI Vs STATE AND OTHERS

paras.text:
C482 No.266 of 2007
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
 Mr. R.K. Shah, Dy. Adv. General (Cri.) for the State.
 Having seen the affidavit filed by the District
Magistrate, Dehradun, annexing therewith the report of
City Magistrate, Dehradun, it appears that the order of
this Court, to remove the encroachment from the
property, in question, has been complied with in letter
and spirit, and there is no encroachment at the spot.
 In the above circumstances, there is nothing further
to be left in this case. Let the record be consigned.
